int[][] ordered_pairs(int[][] pairs)
    int[][] result := []
    for pair := pairs[]
        position := int(#result)
        for: i < int(#result)
            if pair[0] < result[i][0] or (pair[0] == result[i][0] and pair[1] < result[i][1])
                position = i
                break
        result = result[0:<position].concat([pair]).concat(result[position:<int(#result)])
    return result

int[][] minimum_matching(real64[][] costs)
    if #costs == 0 or #costs[0] == 0
        return []
    swapped := #costs > #costs[0]
    values := costs
    if swapped
        values = [for j := (0:<int(#costs[0]))[] then [for i := (0:<int(#costs))[] then costs[i][j]]]
    rows := int(#values)
    columns := int(#values[0])
    real64 infinity := 1.0e100
    real64[] u := [for i := (0:<(int(rows) + 1))[] then 0.0]
    real64[] v := [for j := (0:<(int(columns) + 1))[] then 0.0]
    matched := [for j := (0:<(int(columns) + 1))[] then 0]
    previous := matched
    for: 1 <= row <= rows
        matched[0] = row
        column := 0
        distances := [for j := (0:<(int(columns) + 1))[] then infinity]
        used := [for j := (0:<(int(columns) + 1))[] then false]
        while true
            used[column] = true
            current_row := matched[column]
            delta := infinity
            following := 0
            for: 1 <= candidate <= columns
                if not used[candidate]
                    reduced := values[current_row - 1][candidate - 1] - u[current_row] - v[candidate]
                    if reduced < distances[candidate]
                        distances[candidate] = reduced
                        previous[candidate] = column
                    if distances[candidate] < delta
                        delta = distances[candidate]
                        following = candidate
            for: candidate <= columns
                if used[candidate]
                    u[matched[candidate]] += delta
                    v[candidate] -= delta
                else
                    distances[candidate] -= delta
            column = following
            if matched[column] == 0
                break
        while column != 0
            following := previous[column]
            matched[column] = matched[following]
            column = following
    int[][] pairs := []
    for: 1 <= column <= columns
        if matched[column] != 0
            pairs = pairs.append(if swapped then [column - 1, matched[column] - 1] else [matched[column] - 1, column - 1])
    return ordered_pairs(pairs)

int[][] optimal_assignment(real64[][] costs, bool[][] usable)
    if #costs == 0 or #costs[0] == 0
        return []
    rows := int(#costs)
    columns := int(#costs[0])
    real64 largest := 1.0
    any := false
    for: i < rows
        for: j < columns
            if usable[i][j]
                any = true
                if costs[i][j] > largest
                    largest = costs[i][j]
    if not any
        return []
    smaller := if rows < columns then rows else columns
    penalty := real64(smaller + 1) * (largest + 1.0)
    values := [for i := (0:<int(rows))[] then [for j := (0:<int(columns))[] then (if usable[i][j] then costs[i][j] else penalty)]]
    pairs := minimum_matching(values)
    return [for pair := pairs[] if usable[pair[0]][pair[1]] then pair]

import math
import association = "./association.qui"

real64 squared_distance(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    dx := first[0] - second[0]
    dy := first[1] - second[1]
    return dx * dx + dy * dy

real64 distance(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    value := math.sqrt(squared_distance(first, second))
    return value

real64 ospa(real64[][] first, real64[][] second, real64 cutoff)
    if #first == 0 and #second == 0
        return 0.0
    if #first == 0 or #second == 0
        return cutoff
    smaller := if #first <= #second then first else second
    larger := if #first <= #second then second else first
    real64[][] costs := []
    for point := smaller[]
        real64[] row := []
        for other := larger[]
            clipped := distance(point, other)
            if clipped > cutoff
                clipped = cutoff
            row = row.append(clipped * clipped)
        costs = costs.append(row)
    pairs := association.minimum_matching(costs)
    total := costs[pairs[0][0]][pairs[0][1]]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#pairs)
        total += costs[pairs[i][0]][pairs[i][1]]
    result := math.sqrt((total + cutoff * cutoff * real64(int(#larger) - int(#smaller))) / real64(#larger))
    return result

int[] continuity(int[] labels)
    covered := 0
    groups := 0
    swaps := 0
    previous_label := -1
    previous_covered := false
    delay := -1
    for: offset < int(#labels)
        label := labels[offset]
        if label < 0
            previous_covered = false
            continue
        covered += 1
        if delay < 0
            delay = offset
        if not previous_covered
            groups += 1
        if previous_label >= 0 and label != previous_label
            swaps += 1
        previous_label = label
        previous_covered = true
    breaks := if groups == 0 then 0 else groups - 1
    return [covered, breaks, swaps, delay]

int rounded(real64 value)
    magnitude := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
    result := math.floor(magnitude * 10000.0 + 0.5)
    return if value < 0.0 then -result else result

string fmt(real64 value)
    units := rounded(value)
    negative := units < 0
    if negative
        units = -units
    tail := string(units % 10000)
    return (if negative then "-" else "") + string(units / 10000) + "." + "0" * nat(4 - int(#tail)) + tail

import math
import matrix = "./matrix.qui"
import kalman = "./kalman.qui"

class Filter(real64[] densities, real64[][] transitions, real64[] probabilities, real64 sigma, real64 velocity_variance, real64[] measurement)
    kalman.Filter[] models := [for density := densities[] then kalman.Filter(4, density, sigma, velocity_variance, 0.0, measurement)]

    void .step(real64 interval, real64[] observation)
        predicted := [for j := (0:<2)[] then transitions[0][j] * probabilities[0] + transitions[1][j] * probabilities[1]]
        old_states := [for model := models[] then model.state]
        old_covariances := [for model := models[] then model.covariance]
        real64[] likelihoods := []
        for: j < 2
            w0 := transitions[0][j] * probabilities[0] / predicted[j]
            w1 := transitions[1][j] * probabilities[1] / predicted[j]
            mixed := [for r := (0:<4)[] then w0 * old_states[0][r] + w1 * old_states[1][r]]
            covariance := [for r := (0:<4)[] then [for s := (0:<4)[] then w0 * (old_covariances[0][r][s] + (old_states[0][r] - mixed[r]) * (old_states[0][s] - mixed[s])) + w1 * (old_covariances[1][r][s] + (old_states[1][r] - mixed[r]) * (old_states[1][s] - mixed[s]))]]
            models[j].state = mixed
            models[j].covariance = covariance
            .models[j].predict(interval)
            real64 likelihood := 1.0
            if #observation != 0
                update := .models[j].update(observation)
                root := math.sqrt(matrix.determinant2(update.covariance))
                likelihood = math.exp(-update.distance2 / 2.0) / (2.0 * 3.141592653589793 * root)
            likelihoods = likelihoods.append(likelihood)
        denominator := likelihoods[0] * predicted[0] + likelihoods[1] * predicted[1]
        probabilities = [for j := (0:<2)[] then likelihoods[j] * predicted[j] / denominator]

    real64[] estimate()
        return [for r := (0:<4)[] then probabilities[0] * models[0].state[r] + probabilities[1] * models[1].state[r]]

import math
import matrix = "./matrix.qui"

real64[][] transition(int dimension, real64 interval)
    result := matrix.identity(dimension)
    result[0][2] = interval
    result[1][3] = interval
    if dimension == 6
        result[0][4] = interval * interval / 2.0
        result[1][5] = interval * interval / 2.0
        result[2][4] = interval
        result[3][5] = interval
    return result

real64[][] process_noise(int dimension, real64 interval, real64 density)
    t := interval
    q := density
    int[][] positions := [[0, 0], [0, 2], [2, 2]]
    values := [q * t * t * t / 3.0, q * t * t / 2.0, q * t]
    if dimension == 6
        positions = [[0, 0], [0, 2], [0, 4], [2, 2], [2, 4], [4, 4]]
        values = [q * t * t * t * t * t / 20.0, q * t * t * t * t / 8.0, q * t * t * t / 6.0, q * t * t * t / 3.0, q * t * t / 2.0, q * t]
    result := matrix.zeros(dimension, dimension)
    for: axis < 2
        for: i < int(#positions)
            row := positions[i][0] + axis
            column := positions[i][1] + axis
            result[row][column] = values[i]
            result[column][row] = values[i]
    return result

class Innovation(real64[] residual, real64[][] covariance, real64[][] precision, real64 distance2)
class Update(real64 distance2, real64 log_likelihood, real64[][] covariance)
class Snapshot(real64[] state, real64[][] covariance, real64[] predicted_state, real64[][] predicted_covariance, real64[][] transition_matrix)

class Filter(int dimension, real64 density, real64 sigma, real64 velocity_variance, real64 acceleration_variance, real64[] measurement)
    real64[] state := measurement.concat([for i := (0:<int(dimension - 2))[] then 0.0])
    variances := [sigma * sigma, sigma * sigma, velocity_variance, velocity_variance]
    if dimension == 6
        variances = variances.concat([acceleration_variance, acceleration_variance])
    real64[][] covariance := matrix.diagonal(variances)
    real64[][] h := [for i := (0:<2)[] then [for j := (0:<int(dimension))[] then (if i == j then 1.0 else 0.0)]]
    real64[][] noise := matrix.diagonal([sigma * sigma, sigma * sigma])
    real64[][] transition_matrix := matrix.identity(dimension)
    predicted_state := state
    predicted_covariance := covariance

    void .predict(real64 interval)
        transition_matrix = transition(dimension, interval)
        state = matrix.vector_product(transition_matrix, state)
        covariance = matrix.add(matrix.product(matrix.product(transition_matrix, covariance), matrix.transpose(transition_matrix)), process_noise(dimension, interval, density))
        predicted_state = state
        predicted_covariance = covariance

    Innovation innovation(real64[] incoming)
        residual := matrix.vector_subtract(incoming, matrix.vector_product(h, state))
        innovation_covariance := matrix.add(matrix.product(matrix.product(h, covariance), matrix.transpose(h)), noise)
        precision := matrix.inverse(innovation_covariance)
        return Innovation(residual, innovation_covariance, precision, matrix.quadratic2(residual, precision))

    Update .update(real64[] incoming)
        Innovation value := innovation(incoming)
        gain := matrix.product(matrix.product(covariance, matrix.transpose(h)), value.precision)
        correction := matrix.subtract(matrix.identity(dimension), matrix.product(gain, h))
        state = matrix.vector_add(state, matrix.vector_product(gain, value.residual))
        covariance = matrix.add(matrix.product(matrix.product(correction, covariance), matrix.transpose(correction)), matrix.product(matrix.product(gain, noise), matrix.transpose(gain)))
        real64 log_constant := math.log(real64(2.0) * 3.141592653589793)
        log_determinant := math.log(matrix.determinant2(value.covariance))
        likelihood := -log_constant - log_determinant / 2.0 - value.distance2 / 2.0
        return Update(value.distance2, likelihood, value.covariance)

    Snapshot snapshot()
        return Snapshot(state, covariance, predicted_state, predicted_covariance, transition_matrix)

real64[][] smooth(Snapshot[] history)
    size := int(#history)
    states := [for entry := history[] then entry.state]
    index := size - 2
    while index >= 0
        current := history[index]
        following := history[index + 1]
        gain := matrix.product(matrix.product(current.covariance, matrix.transpose(following.transition_matrix)), matrix.inverse(following.predicted_covariance))
        states[index] = matrix.vector_add(current.state, matrix.vector_product(gain, matrix.vector_subtract(states[index + 1], following.predicted_state)))
        index -= 1
    return states

import math
import matrix = "./matrix.qui"
import kalman = "./kalman.qui"

string[] filter_labels()
    return ["cv", "ca", "abg", "imm", "rts"]
const characters := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"

int integer(string text)
    value := int(text)
    return value

real64 parse_number(string text)
    value := real64(text)
    return value

string[] read_lines(string path)
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    rows := text.split(NL)
    return rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1]

void write_lines(string name, string[] rows)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(rows.join(NL) + NL)

string optional(int value)
    return if value < 0 then "-" else string(value)

string listed(string keyword, string[] values)
    return keyword + " " + (if #values == 0 then "none" else values.join(" "))

real64 path_length(real64[][] positions)
    return matrix.total([for i := (1:<int(#positions))[] then evaluation.distance(positions[i - 1], positions[i])])

real64 rmse(real64[] squared_errors)
    result := math.sqrt(matrix.total(squared_errors) / real64(#squared_errors))
    return result

string filter_scores(real64[] values)
    filter_names := filter_labels()
    best := 0
    string[] items := []
    for: f < 5
        items = items.append(filter_names[f] + " " + evaluation.fmt(values[f]))
        if evaluation.rounded(values[f]) < evaluation.rounded(values[best])
            best = f
    return items.join(" ") + " best " + filter_names[best]

int[][] segments(int[] labels, int start)
    int[][] groups := []
    for: i < int(#labels)
        label := labels[i]
        if label < 0
            continue
        scan_index := start + i
        last := int(#groups) - 1
        if last >= 0 and groups[last][1] + 1 == scan_index and groups[last][2] == label
            groups[last][1] = scan_index
        else
            groups = groups.append([scan_index, scan_index, label])
    return groups

string[] framed(string[][] cells)
    string border := "+" + "-" * #cells[0] + "+"
    return [border].concat([for row := cells[] then "|" + row.join("") + "|"]).concat([border])

class Params(int dimension, real64 qcv, real64 qca, real64 sigma, real64 velocity_variance, real64 acceleration_variance, real64 gate, int confirm_hits, int confirm_window, int delete_misses, real64[] abg, real64[] imm_q, real64[][] transitions, real64[] probabilities, real64 match_distance, real64 cutoff, real64 bound, real64[] edges, real64[] xrange, real64[] yrange, int width, int height)
class Target(int number, real64[][] positions)
class Input(real64[][][] measurements, real64[] times, Target[] targets, Params params)

Input read_inputs()
    real64[][][] measurements := []
    real64[] times := []
    rows := read_lines("input/measurements.csv")
    for row := rows[1:<int(#rows)][]
        fields := row.split(",")
        scan_index := integer(fields[0]) - 1
        while int(#measurements) <= scan_index
            measurements = measurements.append([])
            times = times.append(parse_number(fields[1]))
        measurements[scan_index] = measurements[scan_index].append([parse_number(fields[2]), parse_number(fields[3])])
    scans := int(#measurements)
    Target[] targets := []
    rows = read_lines("input/truth.csv")
    for row := rows[1:<int(#rows)][]
        fields := row.split(",")
        target := integer(fields[0])
        if #targets == 0 or targets[-1].number != target
            targets = targets.append(Target(target, [for k := (0:<int(scans))[] then []]))
        targets[-1].positions[integer(fields[1]) - 1] = [parse_number(fields[2]), parse_number(fields[3])]
    settings := [for row := read_lines("input/params.txt")[] then row.split(" ")]
    params := Params(if settings[0][1] == "CV" then 4 else 6,
        parse_number(settings[1][1]), parse_number(settings[2][1]), parse_number(settings[3][1]), parse_number(settings[4][1]), parse_number(settings[5][1]), parse_number(settings[6][1]),
        integer(settings[7][1]), integer(settings[7][2]), integer(settings[8][1]),
        [for j := [1, 2, 3][] then parse_number(settings[9][j])],
        [parse_number(settings[10][1]), parse_number(settings[10][2])],
        [[parse_number(settings[11][1]), parse_number(settings[11][2])], [parse_number(settings[11][3]), parse_number(settings[11][4])]],
        [parse_number(settings[12][1]), parse_number(settings[12][2])], parse_number(settings[13][1]), parse_number(settings[14][1]), parse_number(settings[15][1]),
        [for value := settings[16][1:<int(#settings[16])][] then parse_number(value)],
        [parse_number(settings[17][1]), parse_number(settings[17][2])], [parse_number(settings[18][1]), parse_number(settings[18][2])], integer(settings[19][1]), integer(settings[19][2]))
    return Input(measurements, times, targets, params)

class Track(int number, int birth, real64[] first_measurement, kalman.Filter primary_filter, int scans)
    last_hit := birth
    confirmation := -1
    deletion := -1
    status := 0
    hits := 1
    consecutive_misses := 0
    real64[][] observations := [for k := (0:<int(scans))[] then []]
    observations[birth] = first_measurement
    real64[] nis_by_scan := [for k := (0:<int(scans))[] then -1.0]
    real64[] nis_values := []
    real64[][][] estimates := []
    real64[][][] primary_covariances := []
    real64[] model_logs := []
    real64[] high := []
    longest_gap := 0
    real64 length := 0.0
    target_index := -1
    int[] primary_matches := [for k := (0:<int(scans))[] then -1]
    int[] common := []
    real64 mean_distance := 0.0

class Analysis(Input data)
    scans := int(#data.measurements)
    target_count := int(#data.targets)
    int primary := if data.params.dimension == 4 then 0 else 1
    Track[] tracks := []
    int[] evaluated := []
    track_rows := ["track,scan,x,y,vx,vy,status"]
    string[] association_log := []
    conflict_measurements := 0
    conflict_tracks := 0
    greedy_differences := 0
    int[][][] labels := [for f := (0:<5)[] then [for b := (0:<int(target_count))[] then [for k := (0:<int(scans))[] then -1]]]
    real64[][] ospa_values := [for f := (0:<5)[] then []]
    int[][] scan_sizes := []
    int[] matched_tracks := [for b := (0:<int(target_count))[] then -1]
    int[][][] continuities := []
    real64[][] position_rmse := [for b := (0:<int(target_count))[] then []]
    real64[][] velocity_rmse := [for b := (0:<int(target_count))[] then []]
    int[] velocity_count := [for b := (0:<int(target_count))[] then 0]
    real64[][] nees := [for b := (0:<int(target_count))[] then []]
    real64[] overall_position := []
    real64[] overall_velocity := []

    kalman.Filter make_filter(int dimension, real64[] measurement)
        density := if dimension == 4 then data.params.qcv else data.params.qca
        return kalman.Filter(dimension, density, data.params.sigma, data.params.velocity_variance, data.params.acceleration_variance, measurement)

    real64[] estimate(int track_index, int filter_index, int scan_index)
        track := tracks[track_index]
        return track.estimates[filter_index][scan_index - track.birth]

    void .track_all_scans()
        p := data.params
        for: scan_index < scans
            live := [for i := (0:<int(#tracks))[] if tracks[i].status != 2 then i]
            measurements := data.measurements[scan_index]
            rows := int(#live)
            columns := int(#measurements)
            if scan_index > 0
                interval := data.times[scan_index] - data.times[scan_index - 1]
                for index := live[]
                    .tracks[index].primary_filter.predict(interval)
            costs := matrix.zeros(rows, columns)
            usable := [for i := (0:<int(rows))[] then [for j := (0:<int(columns))[] then false]]
            row_gates := [for i := (0:<int(rows))[] then 0]
            column_gates := [for j := (0:<int(columns))[] then 0]
            string[] gate_items := []
            for: i < rows
                for: j < columns
                    value := tracks[live[i]].primary_filter.innovation(measurements[j])
                    costs[i][j] = value.distance2
                    if value.distance2 <= p.gate
                        usable[i][j] = true
                        row_gates[i] += 1
                        column_gates[j] += 1
                        gate_items = gate_items.append("{tracks[live[i]].number}:{j + 1}=" + evaluation.fmt(value.distance2))
            assigned := association.optimal_assignment(costs, usable)
            int[][] greedy := []
            used_rows := [for i := (0:<int(rows))[] then false]
            used_columns := [for j := (0:<int(columns))[] then false]
            while true
                selected_row := -1
                selected_column := -1
                real64 smallest := 0.0
                for: i < rows
                    for: j < columns
                        if usable[i][j] and not used_rows[i] and not used_columns[j]
                            if selected_row < 0 or costs[i][j] < smallest
                                smallest = costs[i][j]
                                selected_row = i
                                selected_column = j
                if selected_row < 0
                    break
                greedy = greedy.append([selected_row, selected_column])
                used_rows[selected_row] = true
                used_columns[selected_column] = true
            greedy = association.ordered_pairs(greedy)
            if assigned != greedy
                greedy_differences += 1
            matches := [for i := (0:<int(rows))[] then -1]
            used_columns = [for j := (0:<int(columns))[] then false]
            for pair := assigned[]
                matches[pair[0]] = pair[1]
                used_columns[pair[1]] = true
            string[] missed := []
            string[] confirmed := []
            string[] deleted := []
            for: i < rows
                index := live[i]
                j := matches[i]
                if j >= 0
                    update := .tracks[index].primary_filter.update(measurements[j])
                    tracks[index].observations[scan_index] = measurements[j]
                    tracks[index].nis_by_scan[scan_index] = costs[i][j]
                    tracks[index].last_hit = scan_index
                    tracks[index].hits += 1
                    tracks[index].consecutive_misses = 0
                else
                    tracks[index].consecutive_misses += 1
                    missed = missed.append(string(tracks[index].number))
                if tracks[index].status == 1
                    if tracks[index].consecutive_misses >= p.delete_misses
                        tracks[index].status = 2
                        tracks[index].deletion = scan_index + 1
                        deleted = deleted.append(string(tracks[index].number))
                elif tracks[index].hits >= p.confirm_hits
                    tracks[index].status = 1
                    tracks[index].confirmation = scan_index + 1
                    confirmed = confirmed.append(string(tracks[index].number))
                elif scan_index - tracks[index].birth + 1 >= p.confirm_window
                    tracks[index].status = 2
                    tracks[index].deletion = scan_index + 1
                    deleted = deleted.append(string(tracks[index].number))
            string[] new_items := []
            processed := live
            for: j < columns
                if not used_columns[j]
                    index := int(#tracks)
                    tracks = tracks.append(Track(index + 1, scan_index, measurements[j], make_filter(p.dimension, measurements[j]), scans))
                    processed = processed.append(index)
                    new_items = new_items.append("{index + 1}:{j + 1}")
            conflicts_m := int(#[for count := column_gates[] if count >= 2 then count])
            conflicts_t := int(#[for count := row_gates[] if count >= 2 then count])
            conflict_measurements += conflicts_m
            conflict_tracks += conflicts_t
            tentative_count := int(#[for track := tracks[] if track.status == 0 then 1])
            confirmed_count := int(#[for track := tracks[] if track.status == 1 then 1])
            association_log = association_log.concat(["scan {scan_index + 1} tracks {rows} measurements {columns}", listed("gate", gate_items),
                listed("assign", [for pair := assigned[] then "{tracks[live[pair[0]]].number}:{pair[1] + 1}"]),
                listed("greedy", [for pair := greedy[] then "{tracks[live[pair[0]]].number}:{pair[1] + 1}"]),
                listed("missed", missed), listed("new", new_items), listed("confirmed", confirmed), listed("deleted", deleted),
                "status tentative {tentative_count} confirmed {confirmed_count}", "conflicts measurements {conflicts_m} tracks {conflicts_t}"])
            statuses := ["tentative", "confirmed", "deleted"]
            for index := processed[]
                values := [string(tracks[index].number), string(scan_index + 1)]
                values = values.concat([for value := tracks[index].primary_filter.state[0:<4][] then evaluation.fmt(value)])
                track_rows = track_rows.append(values.append(statuses[tracks[index].status]).join(","))
        evaluated = [for i := (0:<int(#tracks))[] if tracks[i].confirmation >= 0 then i]

    void .compare_filters()
        p := data.params
        for index := evaluated[]
            track := tracks[index]
            track.estimates = [for f := (0:<5)[] then []]
            kalman.Snapshot[] primary_history := []
            for: f < 2
                kalman.Filter model := make_filter(if f == 0 then 4 else 6, track.first_measurement)
                kalman.Snapshot[] history := []
                real64 likelihood := 0.0
                for: track.birth <= scan_index <= track.last_hit
                    if scan_index > track.birth
                        .model.predict(data.times[scan_index] - data.times[scan_index - 1])
                        if #track.observations[scan_index] != 0
                            update := .model.update(track.observations[scan_index])
                            likelihood += update.log_likelihood
                    track.estimates[f] = track.estimates[f].append(model.state[0:<4])
                    history = history.append(model.snapshot())
                track.model_logs = track.model_logs.append(likelihood)
                if f == primary
                    primary_history = history
            track.primary_covariances = [for entry := primary_history[] then entry.covariance]
            track.estimates[4] = [for state := kalman.smooth(primary_history)[] then state[0:<4]]
            real64[] abg_state := track.first_measurement.concat([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
            mixed := imm.Filter(p.imm_q, p.transitions, p.probabilities, p.sigma, p.velocity_variance, track.first_measurement)
            gap := 0
            for: track.birth <= scan_index <= track.last_hit
                observation := track.observations[scan_index]
                if scan_index > track.birth
                    interval := data.times[scan_index] - data.times[scan_index - 1]
                    for: axis < 2
                        position := abg_state[axis]
                        velocity := abg_state[axis + 2]
                        acceleration := abg_state[axis + 4]
                        position = position + interval * velocity + interval * interval * acceleration / 2.0
                        velocity = velocity + interval * acceleration
                        if #observation != 0
                            residual := observation[axis] - position
                            position += p.abg[0] * residual
                            velocity += p.abg[1] * residual / interval
                            acceleration += 2.0 * p.abg[2] * residual / (interval * interval)
                        abg_state[axis] = position
                        abg_state[axis + 2] = velocity
                        abg_state[axis + 4] = acceleration
                    .mixed.step(interval, observation)
                track.estimates[2] = track.estimates[2].append(abg_state[0:<4])
                track.estimates[3] = track.estimates[3].append(mixed.estimate())
                track.high = track.high.append(mixed.probabilities[1])
                gap = if #observation == 0 then gap + 1 else 0
                if gap > track.longest_gap
                    track.longest_gap = gap
                if track.nis_by_scan[scan_index] >= 0.0
                    track.nis_values = track.nis_values.append(track.nis_by_scan[scan_index])
            track.length = path_length(track.estimates[4])
            tracks[index] = track

    void .evaluate_scans()
        for: scan_index < scans
            active := [for index := evaluated[] if tracks[index].birth <= scan_index and scan_index <= tracks[index].last_hit then index]
            present := [for b := (0:<int(target_count))[] if #data.targets[b].positions[scan_index] != 0 then b]
            scan_sizes = scan_sizes.append([int(#present), int(#active)])
            positions := [for b := present[] then data.targets[b].positions[scan_index]]
            for: f < 5
                real64[][] estimates := [for index := active[] then estimate(index, f, scan_index)]
                costs := [for state := estimates[] then [for point := positions[] then evaluation.distance(state, point)]]
                usable := [for row := costs[] then [for value := row[] then value <= data.params.match_distance]]
                pairs := association.optimal_assignment(costs, usable)
                for pair := pairs[]
                    index := active[pair[0]]
                    b := present[pair[1]]
                    labels[f][b][scan_index] = index
                    if f == primary
                        tracks[index].primary_matches[scan_index] = b
                ospa_values[f] = ospa_values[f].append(evaluation.ospa(estimates, positions, data.params.cutoff))
        for: f < 5
            int[][] values := []
            for: b < target_count
                sequence := [for scan_index := (0:<int(scans))[] if #data.targets[b].positions[scan_index] != 0 then labels[f][b][scan_index]]
                values = values.append(evaluation.continuity(sequence))
            continuities = continuities.append(values)

    void .match_tracks()
        rows := int(#evaluated)
        costs := matrix.zeros(rows, target_count)
        usable := [for i := (0:<int(rows))[] then [for b := (0:<int(target_count))[] then false]]
        for: row < rows
            index := evaluated[row]
            track := tracks[index]
            for: b < target_count
                real64[] terms := []
                nearby := false
                for: scan_index < scans
                    exists := #data.targets[b].positions[scan_index] != 0
                    estimated := track.birth <= scan_index and scan_index <= track.last_hit
                    if exists and estimated
                        separation := evaluation.distance(estimate(index, primary, scan_index), data.targets[b].positions[scan_index])
                        if separation < data.params.cutoff
                            nearby = true
                        terms = terms.append(if separation < data.params.cutoff then separation else data.params.cutoff)
                    elif exists or estimated
                        terms = terms.append(data.params.cutoff)
                if nearby
                    usable[row][b] = true
                    costs[row][b] = matrix.total(terms) / real64(#terms)
        pairs := association.optimal_assignment(costs, usable)
        for pair := pairs[]
            index := evaluated[pair[0]]
            b := pair[1]
            matched_tracks[b] = index
            tracks[index].target_index = b
            tracks[index].mean_distance = costs[pair[0]][b]
            tracks[index].common = [for scan_index := (int(tracks[index].birth):<(int(tracks[index].last_hit) + 1))[] if #data.targets[b].positions[scan_index] != 0 then scan_index]

    void .evaluate_errors()
        real64[][] position_errors := [for f := (0:<5)[] then []]
        real64[][] velocity_errors := [for f := (0:<5)[] then []]
        for: b < target_count
            index := matched_tracks[b]
            if index < 0
                continue
            track := tracks[index]
            int[] velocity_scans := []
            real64[][] velocities := []
            for scan_index := track.common[]
                if scan_index > 0 and scan_index + 1 < scans and #data.targets[b].positions[scan_index - 1] != 0 and #data.targets[b].positions[scan_index + 1] != 0
                    velocity_scans = velocity_scans.append(scan_index)
                    interval := data.times[scan_index + 1] - data.times[scan_index - 1]
                    velocities = velocities.append([for axis := (0:<2)[] then (data.targets[b].positions[scan_index + 1][axis] - data.targets[b].positions[scan_index - 1][axis]) / interval])
            velocity_count[b] = int(#velocity_scans)
            for: f < 5
                pe := [for scan_index := track.common[] then evaluation.squared_distance(estimate(index, f, scan_index), data.targets[b].positions[scan_index])]
                ve := [for i := (0:<int(#velocity_scans))[] then evaluation.squared_distance(estimate(index, f, velocity_scans[i])[2:<4], velocities[i])]
                position_rmse[b] = position_rmse[b].append(rmse(pe))
                velocity_rmse[b] = velocity_rmse[b].append(rmse(ve))
                position_errors[f] = position_errors[f].concat(pe)
                velocity_errors[f] = velocity_errors[f].concat(ve)
            for scan_index := track.common[]
                real64[] state := estimate(index, primary, scan_index)
                difference := [for axis := (0:<2)[] then state[axis] - data.targets[b].positions[scan_index][axis]]
                covariance := track.primary_covariances[scan_index - track.birth]
                position_covariance := [covariance[0][0:<2], covariance[1][0:<2]]
                nees[b] = nees[b].append(matrix.quadratic2(difference, matrix.inverse(position_covariance)))
        overall_position = [for values := position_errors[] then rmse(values)]
        overall_velocity = [for values := velocity_errors[] then rmse(values)]

    string[] summary_section()
        measurement_count := 0
        for values := data.measurements[]
            measurement_count += int(#values)
        false_count := 0
        used := 0
        for index := evaluated[]
            matched := false
            for b := tracks[index].primary_matches[]
                matched = matched or b >= 0
            if not matched
                false_count += 1
            used += tracks[index].hits
        lost := int(#[for index := matched_tracks[] if index < 0 then index])
        return ["summary", "scans {scans}", "measurements {measurement_count}", "targets {target_count}", "tracks_created {#tracks}", "tracks_confirmed {#evaluated}", "false_tracks {false_count}", "missed_targets {lost}", "measurements_used {used}", "conflict_measurements {conflict_measurements}", "conflict_tracks {conflict_tracks}", "greedy_differences {greedy_differences}"]

    string[] targets_section()
        lines := ["targets"]
        for target := data.targets[]
            present := [for scan_index := (0:<int(scans))[] if #target.positions[scan_index] != 0 then scan_index]
            first := present[0]
            last := present[-1]
            length := path_length([for scan_index := present[] then target.positions[scan_index]])
            speed := length / (data.times[last] - data.times[first])
            lines = lines.append("target {target.number} first {first + 1} last {last + 1} scans {#present} path " + evaluation.fmt(length) + " mean_speed " + evaluation.fmt(speed))
        return lines

    string[] tracks_section()
        lines := ["tracks"]
        for index := evaluated[]
            track := tracks[index]
            count := int(#track.nis_values)
            inside := int(#[for value := track.nis_values[] if value <= data.params.bound then value])
            average := matrix.total(track.nis_values) / real64(count)
            lines = lines.append("track {track.number} birth {track.birth + 1} confirmed {track.confirmation} end {track.last_hit + 1} deleted " + optional(track.deletion) + " hits {track.hits} misses {track.last_hit - track.birth + 1 - track.hits} longest_gap {track.longest_gap} path " + evaluation.fmt(track.length) + " nis " + evaluation.fmt(average) + " nis_inside {inside}/{count}")
        return lines

    string[] matching_section()
        lines := ["matching"]
        for index := evaluated[]
            track := tracks[index]
            target := if track.target_index < 0 then "-" else string(data.targets[track.target_index].number)
            line := "track {track.number} target {target}"
            if track.target_index >= 0
                line += " common {#track.common} mean_distance " + evaluation.fmt(track.mean_distance)
            count := int(#[for b := track.primary_matches[] if b >= 0 then b])
            groups := segments(track.primary_matches, 1)
            values := [for group := groups[] then "{group[0]}-{group[1]}:{data.targets[group[2]].number}"]
            lines = lines.append(line + " matched_scans {count} " + listed("segments", values))
        return lines

    string[] rmse_section()
        lines := ["rmse"]
        for: b < target_count
            target := data.targets[b].number
            index := matched_tracks[b]
            if index < 0
                lines = lines.append("target {target} track -")
            else
                lines = lines.concat(["target {target} track {tracks[index].number} common {#tracks[index].common} " + filter_scores(position_rmse[b]), "target {target} velocity {velocity_count[b]} " + filter_scores(velocity_rmse[b])])
        return lines.concat(["overall position " + filter_scores(overall_position), "overall velocity " + filter_scores(overall_velocity)])

    string[] consistency_section()
        lines := ["consistency"]
        for: b < target_count
            target := data.targets[b].number
            index := matched_tracks[b]
            if index < 0
                lines = lines.append("target {target} track -")
            else
                inside := int(#[for value := nees[b][] if value <= data.params.bound then value])
                average := matrix.total(nees[b]) / real64(#nees[b])
                lines = lines.append("target {target} track {tracks[index].number} nees " + evaluation.fmt(average) + " inside {inside}/{#nees[b]}")
        real64[] values := []
        for index := evaluated[]
            values = values.concat(tracks[index].nis_values)
        edges := data.params.edges
        observed := [for i := (0:<(int(#edges) + 1))[] then 0]
        for value := values[]
            bin_index := 0
            while bin_index < int(#edges) and value >= edges[bin_index]
                bin_index += 1
            observed[bin_index] += 1
        real64[] expected := []
        real64 lower := 0.0
        for: i <= int(#edges)
            real64 upper_probability := if i == int(#edges) then 0.0 else math.exp(-edges[i] / 2.0)
            expected = expected.append(real64(#values) * (math.exp(-lower / 2.0) - upper_probability))
            if i < int(#edges)
                lower = edges[i]
        counts := [for value := observed[] then string(value)].join(" ")
        expectations := [for value := expected[] then evaluation.fmt(value)].join(" ")
        return lines.append("nis_histogram total {#values} observed {counts} expected {expectations}")

    string[] models_section()
        lines := ["models"]
        for index := evaluated[]
            track := tracks[index]
            cv := track.model_logs[0]
            ca := track.model_logs[1]
            better := if cv >= ca then "cv" else "ca"
            lines = lines.append("track {track.number} updates {#track.nis_values} cv " + evaluation.fmt(cv) + " ca " + evaluation.fmt(ca) + " better {better}")
        return lines

    string[] ospa_section()
        lines := ["ospa cutoff " + evaluation.fmt(data.params.cutoff) + " order 2", "scan targets tracks cv ca abg imm rts"]
        for: scan_index < scans
            values := [for f := (0:<5)[] then evaluation.fmt(ospa_values[f][scan_index])].join(" ")
            lines = lines.append("{scan_index + 1} {scan_sizes[scan_index][0]} {scan_sizes[scan_index][1]} {values}")
        averages := [for values := ospa_values[] then evaluation.fmt(matrix.total(values) / real64(scans))].join(" ")
        return lines.append("mean " + averages)

    string[] continuity_section()
        filter_names := filter_labels()
        lines := ["continuity"]
        for: f < 5
            totals := [0, 0, 0]
            for values := continuities[f][]
                for: j < 3
                    totals[j] += values[j]
            lines = lines.append("{filter_names[f]} covered {totals[0]} breaks {totals[1]} swaps {totals[2]}")
            for: b < target_count
                count := int(#[for point := data.targets[b].positions[] if #point != 0 then point])
                values := continuities[f][b]
                lines = lines.append("  target {data.targets[b].number} scans {count} covered {values[0]} breaks {values[1]} swaps {values[2]} delay " + optional(values[3]))
        return lines

    string[] imm_section()
        lines := ["imm"]
        for index := evaluated[]
            track := tracks[index]
            largest := 0
            count := 0
            int[] high_labels := []
            for: i < int(#track.high)
                if track.high[i] > track.high[largest]
                    largest = i
                high_noise := track.high[i] > 0.5
                if high_noise
                    count += 1
                high_labels = high_labels.append(if high_noise then 0 else -1)
            groups := segments(high_labels, track.birth + 1)
            values := [for group := groups[] then "{group[0]}-{group[1]}"]
            average := matrix.total(track.high) / real64(#track.high)
            lines = lines.append("track {track.number} mean_high " + evaluation.fmt(average) + " max_high " + evaluation.fmt(track.high[largest]) + " at {track.birth + largest + 1} high_scans {count} " + listed("segments", values))
        return lines

    string[] evaluation_lines()
        string[][] sections := [summary_section(), targets_section(), tracks_section(), matching_section(), rmse_section(), consistency_section(), models_section(), ospa_section(), continuity_section(), imm_section()]
        string[] lines := []
        for section := sections[]
            if #lines != 0
                lines = lines.append("")
            lines = lines.concat(section)
        return lines

    int[] plot_cell(real64[] point)
        p := data.params
        dx := (p.xrange[1] - p.xrange[0]) / real64(p.width)
        dy := (p.yrange[1] - p.yrange[0]) / real64(p.height)
        column := math.floor((point[0] - p.xrange[0]) / dx)
        row := math.floor((p.yrange[1] - point[1]) / dy)
        return if column >= 0 and column < p.width and row >= 0 and row < p.height then [row, column] else []

    string[] plot_lines()
        filter_names := filter_labels()
        p := data.params
        trajectory := [for r := (0:<int(p.height))[] then [for c := (0:<int(p.width))[] then " "]]
        for target := data.targets[]
            for point := target.positions[]
                if #point != 0
                    int[] cell := plot_cell(point)
                    if #cell != 0
                        trajectory[cell[0]][cell[1]] = "."
        for: order < int(#evaluated)
            index := evaluated[order]
            for state := tracks[index].estimates[4][]
                int[] cell := plot_cell(state)
                if #cell != 0
                    trajectory[cell[0]][cell[1]] = characters[order]
        lines := ["tracks x " + evaluation.fmt(p.xrange[0]) + " " + evaluation.fmt(p.xrange[1]) + " y " + evaluation.fmt(p.yrange[0]) + " " + evaluation.fmt(p.yrange[1]) + " size {p.width} {p.height}"]
        lines = lines.concat(framed(trajectory))
        character_indices := [for i := (0:<int(#tracks))[] then -1]
        for: order < int(#evaluated)
            index := evaluated[order]
            character_indices[index] = order
            b := tracks[index].target_index
            target := if b < 0 then "-" else string(data.targets[b].number)
            lines = lines.append("{characters[order]} track {tracks[index].number} target {target}")
        counts := [for r := (0:<int(p.height))[] then [for c := (0:<int(p.width))[] then 0]]
        for measurements := data.measurements[]
            for point := measurements[]
                int[] cell := plot_cell(point)
                if #cell != 0
                    counts[cell[0]][cell[1]] += 1
        density := [for row := counts[] then [for count := row[] then (if count == 0 then " " elif count < 10 then string(count) else "#")]]
        lines = lines.concat(["", "measurements"]).concat(framed(density)).concat(["", "timeline"])
        for: b < target_count
            string[] timeline := []
            for: scan_index < scans
                index := labels[primary][b][scan_index]
                character := if #data.targets[b].positions[scan_index] == 0 then " " elif index < 0 then "." else characters[character_indices[index]]
                timeline = timeline.append(character)
            lines = lines.append("{data.targets[b].number} |" + timeline.join("") + "|")
        int[] heights := [for value := ospa_values[primary][] then math.floor(10.0 * value / p.cutoff)]
        bars := [for r := (0:<10)[] then [for height := heights[] then (if height >= 10 - r then "#" else " ")]]
        return lines.concat(["", "ospa " + filter_names[primary]]).concat(framed(bars))

    string[] smoothed_rows()
        rows := ["track,scan,x,y,vx,vy"]
        for index := evaluated[]
            track := tracks[index]
            for: track.birth <= scan_index <= track.last_hit
                values := [string(track.number), string(scan_index + 1)]
                values = values.concat([for value := estimate(index, 4, scan_index)[] then evaluation.fmt(value)])
                rows = rows.append(values.join(","))
        return rows

void run()
    analysis := Analysis(read_inputs())
    .analysis.track_all_scans()
    .analysis.compare_filters()
    .analysis.evaluate_scans()
    .analysis.match_tracks()
    .analysis.evaluate_errors()
    write_lines("tracks.csv", analysis.track_rows)
    write_lines("smoothed.csv", analysis.smoothed_rows())
    write_lines("association_log.txt", analysis.association_log)
    write_lines("evaluation.txt", analysis.evaluation_lines())
    write_lines("track_plot.txt", analysis.plot_lines())

run()

real64 total(real64[] values)
    if #values == 0
        return 0.0
    result := values[0]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#values)
        result += values[i]
    return result

real64[][] zeros(int rows, int columns)
    return [for i := (0:<int(rows))[] then [for j := (0:<int(columns))[] then 0.0]]

real64[][] diagonal(real64[] values)
    size := int(#values)
    result := zeros(size, size)
    for: i < size
        result[i][i] = values[i]
    return result

real64[][] identity(int size)
    return diagonal([for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 1.0])

real64[][] transpose(real64[][] values)
    return [for j := (0:<int(#values[0]))[] then [for i := (0:<int(#values))[] then values[i][j]]]

real64[][] add(real64[][] first, real64[][] second)
    return [for i := (0:<int(#first))[] then [for j := (0:<int(#first[i]))[] then first[i][j] + second[i][j]]]

real64[][] subtract(real64[][] first, real64[][] second)
    return [for i := (0:<int(#first))[] then [for j := (0:<int(#first[i]))[] then first[i][j] - second[i][j]]]

real64[] vector_add(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    return [for i := (0:<int(#first))[] then first[i] + second[i]]

real64[] vector_subtract(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    return [for i := (0:<int(#first))[] then first[i] - second[i]]

real64[][] product(real64[][] first, real64[][] second)
    return [for row := first[] then [for j := (0:<int(#second[0]))[] then total([for k := (0:<int(#row))[] then row[k] * second[k][j]])]]

real64[] vector_product(real64[][] values, real64[] vector)
    return [for row := values[] then total([for k := (0:<int(#vector))[] then row[k] * vector[k]])]

real64[][] inverse(real64[][] values)
    size := int(#values)
    unit := identity(size)
    augmented := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then values[i].concat(unit[i])]
    for: column < size
        pivot := augmented[column][column]
        for: j < 2 * size
            augmented[column][j] /= pivot
        for: row < size
            if row != column
                factor := augmented[row][column]
                for: j < 2 * size
                    augmented[row][j] -= factor * augmented[column][j]
    return [for row := augmented[] then row[size:<2 * size]]

real64 determinant2(real64[][] values)
    return values[0][0] * values[1][1] - values[0][1] * values[1][0]

real64 quadratic2(real64[] vector, real64[][] values)
    return vector[0] * (values[0][0] * vector[0] + values[0][1] * vector[1]) + vector[1] * (values[1][0] * vector[0] + values[1][1] * vector[1])
